opportunities.name: CPA CE/CPE Course on Cost Segregation & Depreciation Strategy
opportunities.summary: Accredited providers (Western CPE, LumiQ, Barbri, CPA Academy) sell or give away CPE courses on cost segregation and depreciation to CPAs, showing a real market of CPAs paying for this content. Dustan lacks NASBA CPE-provider accreditation, so he cannot easily issue credit himself within 30 days; flagged here as cost-seg-adjacent per the brief, but not a fast first-dollar path as-is.

claims.statement: Western CPE sells a 'Cost Segregation & ITC Overview' as a paid CPE webcast product

claims.source_excerpt: Explore LumiQ's best-in-class real estate accounting continuing education courses ... Tax Planning with Cost Segregation Studies.

claims.statement: Dustan is not a CPA and no evidence was found of NASBA CPE-provider registration, which is required to issue CPE credit
claims.source_excerpt: This CPE course focuses on cost segregation and Investment Tax Credit strategies.

opportunities.owned_channel: Supabase CPA referral contacts (direct target audience) — but issuing accredited CPE requires infrastructure Dustan does not own
opportunities.fulfillment: Would require partnering with an accredited CPE platform; not a pure zero-cost digital download as-is
opportunities.first_dollar_path: Not clearly achievable in 30 days without CPE accreditation or a platform partner; an unaccredited referral-partner briefing webinar is a weaker fallback with no CE credit to sell
why_it_might_fail: LEGAL FLAG: course content on depreciation/tax strategy risks unlicensed tax advice if written without a licensed CPA co-author
COMPETITION FLAG: overlaps with free CPE webinars other cost-seg firms (including CSSI-style firms) already run as referral generation
No NASBA CPE-provider accreditation in hand, and none of the specific per-course prices for Western CPE/LumiQ/Barbri were shown in search results

disagreements: Sources disagree on typical cost-segregation study price: CSSI's own FAQ says studies 'typically start around $2,500+', while corporatetaxadvisors.com puts the typical range at $8,000-$15,000 (up to $60,000). Both are tagged as facts from their respective source pages but conflict with each other.

The 'Low in stock, only 1 left' label on the Etsy 1031 Exchange Checklist listing could indicate genuine scarcity or could be a marketing tactic common on digital-download listings; treated as an assumption, not a demand fact.
